canonical_form: between(a, b, c), same_side(a, c, L) => same_side(a, b, L)

members.canonical_form: between(a, b, c), same_side(a, c, L) => same_side(a, b, L)
members.name: pasch_1
members.statement: ∀ (a b c : Point) (L : Line), (between a b c) ∧ (a.sameSide c L) → a.sameSide b L

members.canonical_form: between(a, b, c), on_line(a, L), on_line(b, L) => same_side(b, c, L)
members.name: pasch_2
members.statement: ∀ (a b c : Point) (L : Line), (between a b c) ∧ (a.onLine L) ∧ ¬(b.onLine L) → b.sameSide c L

members.canonical_form: between(a, b, c), on_line(b, L) => same_side(a, c, L)
members.name: pasch_3
members.statement: ∀ (a b c : Point) (L : Line), (between a b c) ∧ (b.onLine L) → ¬(a.sameSide c L)

members.canonical_form: on_line(b, L), on_line(b, M), same_side(a, c, L) => between(a, b, c)
members.name: pasch_4
members.statement: ∀ (a b c : Point) (L M : Line), (L ≠ M) ∧ (b.onLine L) ∧ (b.onLine M) ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a c M ∧ (a ≠ b) ∧ (c ≠ b) ∧ ¬(a.sameSide c L) → between a b c

statement: If b is  between a and c and a and c are on the same side of L, then a and b are on the same side of L
title: pasch
